→ preview thumbnail + filename appear; signature_mode auto-flips to 'Signature Image'
→ click 'Save' (existing Settings save button) — signature_file_id is persisted
→ open any invoice → PDF Preview shows the image inside the right-side sig cell above the signatory name/designation

scenarios.name: Signature Image field visible on Settings under 'Invoice Presentation (Iter134)'
'Upload Signature' button visible when no image is configured
PNG upload succeeds via existing /api/files/upload with category=signature, linked_type=company
GIF (disallowed MIME) rejected 400/415 by existing Iter129-sec gate
file_id automatically assigned to signature_file_id — no manual copy/paste
'Replace Signature' button re-opens the file picker; new file_id supersedes old
'Remove' button detaches (signature_file_id → ''); old file retained for audit
PDF renders signature image + signatory name + designation in right-side sig cell
Contradiction guard still blocks 'signature not required' phrasing while signature configured
Owner/Admin only — normal viewer/accountant cannot save Settings
Existing tenants with a manually-pasted signature_file_id continue to work

known_limitations: 'Remove' performs a soft detach only (clears signature_file_id) — the underlying uploaded file remains in Files for audit history. If you truly want to erase the file, delete it from the Files page.
The signature preview thumbnail is fetched via /files/{id}/download with the session token as a `_t` query param — the same token flow already used by other in-page image previews.
DSC option remains disabled in the Signature Mode dropdown — future turn only.
No bulk PDF regeneration on signature change — old already-downloaded PDFs still show the previous signature (or none). This matches Iter134 behaviour; regeneration polish is on the P2 backlog.
